resource: A character name on the chat wire: a line's speaker or a private message's recipient
allocation_impact: The decoder refuses a name above 120 bytes before copying it; it is part of the 1,148-byte intent and 1,194-byte line bounds.
boundary_tests: max=120: a private intent and a room line with a 120-byte name round-trip
max+1=121: a 121-byte name is refused in both directions
notes: The sender name bound of the CHAT-0 §5 relay payload; revision 1 names are at most 29 ASCII letters (CHARACTER_AUTHORITY_PLATFORM_BOUNDARY §6.1). Registered by OTV2-20261001-chat-1b-1.
